02What We Do — and What We Do Not Do

We provide renovation project management and coordination: survey and scope, design direction, budgeting and programming, contractor selection, permits and approvals coordination, procurement, site coordination, quality control, snagging and handover.

We are not a contracting company and we do not carry out construction work. Building work is performed by licensed contractors and specialist trades appointed for the project. Where those parties contract directly with you, their own terms, warranties and liabilities apply to their work.

03Website Content

The content of this website is provided for general information. It describes the way we work; it is not an offer, a quotation or a commitment to any particular scope, cost or timeline. Costs and durations are deliberately not published here because they depend entirely on the scope, the unit and the building.

The apartment drawing on the home page is an illustration created for this website. It does not depict a specific client project, and the before/after comparison is drawn artwork rather than photography.

04The Payback Estimator

The renovation payback estimator is a calculator, not a forecast. It performs simple arithmetic on the figures you type into it and contains no market data, no assumptions of ours and no prediction about your property.

It is not financial advice, investment advice, a valuation or a projection of returns. It ignores finance costs, taxes, vacancy, platform fee changes and the time value of money. You should not make an investment decision on the basis of its output, and we accept no liability for decisions taken in reliance on it.

05Enquiries
